channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Green cancels D.C. trip to avoid having Sylvia Luke fill in as governor
item.description: Gov. Josh Green has canceled his upcoming plans to travel to Washington, D.C., for the annual National Governors Association’s Winter Meeting to avoid having Lt. Gov. Sylvia Luke fill in for him as acting governor after she acknowledged Monday that she may be the “influential state legislator” who is being investigated for allegedly accepted $35,000 in a bag in 2022.

item.title: Judge blocks Pentagon’s effort to punish Senator Mark Kelly
item.description: WASHINGTON >> A U.S. judge blocked the Pentagon today from reducing Senator Mark Kelly’s retired military rank and pension pay as punishment after he urged troops to reject unlawful orders.

item.title: Americans are paying the bill for tariffs, despite Trump’s claims
item.description: President Donald Trump has frequently claimed that foreign countries were paying for his tariffs, not Americans. But as economists predicted, that is largely turning out not to be the case.

item.title: Separate crashes across Oahu seriously injure 4 people
item.description: A slew of traffic collisions — from Manoa to Haleiwa — sent four people to hospital emergency rooms in serious condition this morning.

item.title: DHS shutdown looms as Congress leaves Washington with no deal
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Lawmakers left Washington today without a deal on an immigration enforcement overhaul, virtually guaranteeing a partial shutdown of the Homeland Security Department when current funding runs out this weekend.

item.title: South Korea’s Choi upsets Chloe Kim to claim women’s halfpipe gold
item.description: LIVIGNO, Italy >> South Korea’s Choi Ga-on denied American Chloe Kim a three-peat in the women’s snowboard halfpipe at the Winter Olympics today, staging a stunning comeback from a crash to win gold on a snowy night in the Italian Alps.

item.title: Union issues strike notice for Hale Nani nursing home in Makiki
item.description: Another Hawaii health care workers strike may be on the horizon, this time at the Hale Nani Rehabilitation & Nursing Center in Makiki.

item.title: Justice Department’s antitrust head steps down after turbulent tenure
item.description: The head of the U.S. Justice Department’s antitrust division stepped down today less than a year after being appointed by President Donald Trump, marking the highest profile departure in a battle within the administration over policing anti-competitive conduct.

item.title: New 4-year bus pact reached with Local 996, OTS says
item.description: Following months of back-and-forth negotiations, Oahu Transit Services Inc., which operates TheBus and TheHandi-Van routes on behalf of the City and County of Honolulu, announced this evening that it had reached an agreement with its labor union that represents hundreds of bus operators, mechanics and support staff.

item.title: Win in Bakersfield has Rainbows alone atop Big West
item.description: Quandre “Dre” Bullock scored 19 points and Harry Rouhliadeff and Isaac “Big Fish” Johnson each had 17 as the Hawaii basketball team defeated Cal State Bakersfield 89-74 to move into sole possession of first place in the Big West.
